title: Testosterone Treatment for Hypogonadal Men
brief_summary: Demonstrate efficacy and safety of Testosterone Gel 1.62% for the treatment of hypogonadal men
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Low T males 18 - 80 years of age

Exclusion Criteria:

* Normal T levels
* Elevated Prostatic Specific Antigen (PSA)
